set_aside.subject: list_project_payments
set_aside.text: - list_project_payments: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST read only through list_project_payments of the ProjectTrackingRepository the project_tracking accessor of that transaction returns, never the same-named legacy PortalTransaction method, and close the read transaction by rollback without using legacy tracking methods.
